# MangaHere fixtures

`series-page.html` and `hunter-reader.html` retain the stripped [Hunter X Hunter](https://newm.mangahere.cc/manga/hunter_x_hunter/) catalog and first chapter: 425 chapter links and 33 reader pages. Browser tests replace image responses with small raster controls while preserving the declared image paths.

`packed-reader.html` retains the earlier 14-page packed-reader vector as additional protocol coverage. The Hunter X Hunter captures exercise metadata and reader parsing; generated image bytes exercise the deterministic output workflow.
